title: Schumer Amendment to NDAA gutted; Mike Turner role

tellings.quote: just look at last year we had this Schumer Amendment to the National Defense authorization act which got entirely gutted

plain: The UAP Disclosure Act, an amendment put forward in the US Senate on 13 July 2023 by Chuck Schumer and Mike Rounds to the yearly defense bill, to force release of government records on UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs), was 'entirely gutted' before it passed, says Jesse Michels. He says this himself, pointing to Congressman Mike Turner's role in it, as proof of how hard parts of government push back against disclosure.
